assertion.hypotheses: The complete relative ring-class derivative and once-only descent supply these classes with the stated restriction identity. A uniform2^e kills all relevant upper-field2-primary torsion; a≥m+e and rho(Fr_ell) congruent to J modulo2^(a+1). The actual norm/congruence relations and good reduction are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every finite derivative set I and each retained new good inert prime outside6fND_K, with the same once-fixed multiplierL.

assertion.uniformity: One exponent e and one multiplierL work independently of K,f,I,m and finite family size. Required precision is the maximum over the finite set, not repeated descent.
assertion.constants: a≥m+e and the additional congruence bit2^(a+1), which pays for division by2 in the derivative sum.
assertion.normalizations: Compare the inertia correction to the actual integer-quotient point U0, not an arbitrary division point. Projection on torsion is multiplication by2^(a−m). Tame generator and chosen place/Frobenius are retained.

assertion.limit_order: Perform all other derivatives; descend once; choose an exact restricted Kummer representative; kill the bounded torsion error at projection; prove the new finite coordinate zero by a local division point; only afterward apply character coefficients.
